name: line-shadow-text
title: Line Shadow Text
description: A text component with a moving line shadow.

props.name: children
props.description: The text to render; the shadow copy is drawn from it via `attr(data-text)`.

props.name: shadowColor
props.description: Colour of the moving line shadow. Pass a theme variable such as `var(--foreground)` to follow light / dark mode.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Motion props such as `initial` and `animate` are passed through to it.
